Changelog:
The location entry in the server info bar now has its own tooltip text box, next to the one for the bar itself. It uses the same tags, and you can type \n to start a new line. Leave it empty to keep the default tooltip.

The tooltip no longer ends with a "Click to copy" line, so it only shows the location. Clicking the entry still copies it.
